name: Argentina
alt: A world map with a long, wedge-shaped highlighted country tapering to a point near the southern tip of a continent.
facts: One of its glaciers alone covers more ground than its capital city does.
Tango dancing was born in dance halls here, packed long ago with immigrants from all over the world.
It stretches so far south that its southern tip is closer to icy Antarctica than to its own tropical north.

name: Bolivia
alt: A world map with a landlocked highlighted country high in the mountains, with no coastline touching any ocean.
facts: It has two capital cities instead of one — a rare setup most countries don't bother with.
Its vast salt flat turns into a giant mirror after it rains, perfectly reflecting the whole sky.
One of its major cities sits so high in the mountains that newcomers sometimes need days just to catch their breath.

name: Brazil
alt: A world map with a huge highlighted landmass taking up most of the eastern bulge of a continent.
facts: More than half of the world's largest rainforest grows entirely within its borders.
It's the only country on its continent where people mostly speak Portuguese instead of Spanish.
Soccer is loved here so deeply that the whole country seems to pause for every big match.

name: Chile
alt: A world map with an extremely long, narrow highlighted strip running down the western edge of a continent, squeezed between mountains and ocean.
facts: It's so long and thin that it stretches from bone-dry desert in the north to icy glaciers in the south.
Its night skies are so clear and dark that astronomers from all over the world build giant telescopes here.
Part of its northern desert is so dry that some patches have never recorded a drop of rain.

name: Colombia
alt: A world map with a highlighted country in the northwest corner of a continent, touching two different oceans at once.
facts: It's one of the few countries on Earth with coastline on two completely different oceans.
It grows and exports so much coffee that the smell of roasting beans is practically a national symbol.
It's home to more known bird species than any other country on the planet.

name: Ecuador
alt: A world map with a small highlighted country straddling the equator, with a cluster of tiny dots far out in the ocean to its west.
facts: Its name literally means 'equator' in Spanish, after the line that runs right through it.
A famous set of islands far out in its ocean territory is where a young scientist once studied unique wildlife that helped shape a famous theory.
Thanks to the Earth's bulge near the equator, the peak of one of its volcanoes is the point on the planet's surface farthest from its core.

name: Guyana
alt: A world map with a small highlighted country on the northeast coast of a continent, mostly covered in thick green forest.
facts: Its name comes from an old word meaning 'land of many waters,' thanks to its many rivers and waterfalls.
It's home to a waterfall more than four times taller than a famous one on the border of the US and Canada.
Unlike most of its neighbors, English is the language most people here grow up speaking.

name: Paraguay
alt: A world map with a landlocked highlighted country in the middle of a continent, with no coastline touching any ocean.
facts: Almost everyone here grows up speaking two languages — Spanish and an Indigenous language called Guaraní.
It shares one of the largest dams on Earth with a neighboring country, producing enormous amounts of electricity.
It's one of only two countries on its continent with no coastline at all.

name: Peru
alt: A world map with a highlighted country along the western coast of a continent, stretching from coastal desert up into high mountains.
facts: A famous mountaintop city built by an ancient empire sat hidden in its peaks for centuries before being rediscovered about a hundred years ago.
It's home to a lake so high in the mountains that boats woven entirely from reeds still float across it today.
It's considered the birthplace of the potato, with thousands of different varieties still grown here.

name: Suriname
alt: A world map with a small highlighted country on the northeast coast of a continent, almost entirely covered by dense rainforest.
facts: More of its land is covered by rainforest than almost any other country on Earth.
It's the smallest independent country on its entire continent.
Thanks to its history, Dutch is its official language — the only country on its continent where that's true.

name: Uruguay
alt: A world map with a small highlighted country tucked between two much larger neighbors on a continent's southeastern coast.
facts: It was one of the first countries in the world to make voting completely secret, among other early reforms.
It hosted, and won, the very first soccer World Cup ever played.
There are several times more cattle here than there are people.

name: Venezuela
alt: A world map with a highlighted country along the northern coast of a continent, touching the Caribbean Sea.
facts: It's home to the tallest waterfall in the world, with water that falls so far it turns to mist before reaching the ground.
It holds more proven oil reserves underground than any other country on Earth.
Lightning flashes almost nonstop over one of its lakes, lighting up the night sky on most nights of the year.
